# Glow Lab NG

> Skincare clinic at 14 Admiralty Way, Lekki Phase 1, Lagos, Nigeria. We help women across Lagos and internationally clear acne, fade dark spots, and balance uneven skin tone without bleaching.

Glow Lab NG builds gentle six-week skincare plans calibrated for light, olive, warm brown, and melanin-rich complexions using NAFDAC-approved treatments and 0 bleaching agents. Over 2,500 clients treated with a 4.9/5 average rating across 1,100+ reviews.

## Clinic Details
- **Clinic Name**: Glow Lab NG
- **Location**: 14 Admiralty Way, Lekki Phase 1, Lagos, Nigeria
- **Service Scope**: In-clinic appointments in Lekki, Lagos and remote skin consultations worldwide
- **Opening Hours**: Monday - Saturday, 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM WAT
- **Free Skin Consultation**: Book via website form or WhatsApp at https://wa.me/2348012345678
- **Bleaching Policy**: Zero bleaching agents (no hydroquinone bleaching cocktails, no harsh steroids)

## Quick Answers (FAQ)
- **Will treatments bleach my skin?** No. Glow Lab NG does not perform skin bleaching and uses 0 bleaching agents; treatments work with your natural tone to even it out.
- **How long before I see results?** Most clients notice visible improvement in 3 to 4 weeks, with full results in 6 to 8 weeks.
- **Is it safe for sensitive skin and all skin tones?** Yes. Every treatment is calibrated for sensitive, light, olive, and melanin-rich skin without harsh bleaching agents.
- **What do I need to bring for my first visit?** Just yourself. A full skin analysis is included on your first visit.
